label: SCG I.22 union causation gives a non-unified union a source not other than the esse (inference)
rule: Obtain a source from n.6 union causation; the two-case n.4 theorem excludes that it is other than the esse
meaning: Composes n.6's union causation with the two-case n.4 theorem, in the dependence sense PER_SE_NECESSARY_2, without n.2 coverage. Non-transcription: it reuses dependent_conjunction_not_quiddity on the source supplied by n.6. A genuine quiddity joined to a per se necessary esse must either be one per se with it (the co-fundamental option) or have a joining source that is not other than the esse (constructively: some s with not s ≠ e; the bound type does not say every source is the esse, though by dependent_conjunction_not_quiddity under the same premises no source is other than it). This self-sourced residual is not refuted here; n.6's self-causation clause is not encoded. Attribution deferred; no root obligation is discharged.
